review.notes: All 22 physical pages scanned with a 5-gram PDF-text-to-OCR word-coverage pass. The main defect class: Figure 7's deep-parsing demo on physical p.13 (Goldman Sachs note input + parsed Result panel) had 13 of its figure-internal banner lines promoted to Markdown headings; all were demoted to plain text after visual verification of the demo layout. Remaining weak-gram diffs are figure-internal chart labels (Figure 1 axes, Figure 8/9/10 demo content: container captions, chemistry tables) shown by embedded figures, plus hyphenation. One underscore escape fixed inside the demoted sub_title label. Printed Contents pages, heading hierarchy, tables and references otherwise match the print.

patches.evidence: Physical p.13 renders Figure 7, the deep-parsing demo: an input Goldman Sachs 'Macro news and views' research note image and the model's parsed markdown Result panel. All these lines are banner/section text inside the demo figure images (verified on a 110 dpi full-page render); OCR promoted them to Markdown headings, polluting the reader's section structure. Demoted to plain text; the transcription itself is kept because the figure is embedded.
